thread:
Asha (PM): Quick thread 1: planning the seed rollout for the model swap next week. Goal: avoid oscillation, give tenants control, and surface early quality divergence. Propose tenant-aware seed traffic + progressive soft-degrade ladder. Thoughts?

Ben (Eng): Sounds good. Suggest seed steps per-region: 0 -> 2% -> 10% -> 30% -> 100%. Smaller initial step (2%) to catch noisy tenants. 15m stability at 2% and 10% steps, 30m at 30%.

Tomas (SRE): Add: per-region circuit tiers. If CPU/GPU >90% OR p95 latency increase >25% -> demote region to soft-degrade (tier1). If errors p95 >0.8% -> rollback region (tier2).

Priya (CustomerOps): For customers flagged as "sensitive" (billing/widgets), we need opt-out + scheduled opt-in window. Also want automatic email + portal banner when they hit >5%.

Nate (Sales): Please add a simple API so CS/Acct can flip opt-out for a tenant: `POST /v1/tenants/:id/rollout` body `{"state":"opt-out"}`. We need webhook when their tenant is bumped.

Ben (Eng): Implemented in controller: per-tenant caps and a token-budget limiter. Example flagset:
```
rollout:
  seed_enabled: true
  steps: [2,10,30,100]
  stability_minutes: {2:15,10:15,30:30}
  per_tenant_cap_qps: 200
  token_budget_per_min: 10000
  opt_out_api: /v1/tenants/{id}/rollout
  fallback_model: model-1-quant
  degrade_ladder: [disable_rerank, cap_tokens:512, fallback_model]
```

Tomas (SRE): Observability: per-tenant and per-region metrics: p50/p95 latency, error rate, embedding-sim delta (see below), token-cost delta, queueing delay. Add canary healthcheck `/canary/pulse?region=...`. If non-200 twice -> pause.

Asha (PM): Quality gate idea: run live A/B on a small eval prompt set and compute embedding cosine similarity between new & baseline. If mean cosine < 0.88 (or drop of >0.05 from baseline), fire a QUALITY alert (no auto-rollback). That goes to #product and #support for triage.

Priya (CustomerOps): Excellent 1. For sensitive tenants, require explicit 1x PM + 1x Eng ack before >25%. Also CS must confirm email sent 24h in advance for scheduled rollouts.

Ben (Eng): Rollback ladder: 1) reduce affected slice by 50% and remove largest tenants from slice for 10m, 2) if still failing, apply soft-degrade steps (disable rerank, cap tokens), 3) if still failing, rollback to previous model in that region, 4) global fallback to quantized variant if capacity gone.

deploy-bot: Controller: seeding region=us-east1 step=2% started_by=Asha ts=1751010000 :rocket:

Tomas (SRE): On-call: keep an eye on `embedding-sim` and `token-cost` dashboards for first 90m. If we see >12% token-cost increase for a region, escalate.

Nate (Sales): Tag me on Acme and Peak tenants when they hit 10% so I can check adoption and CS comms.

Asha (PM): Decision recap:
- Tenant-aware seed: [2,10,30,100] with small initial step.
- Per-tenant caps + opt-out API + portal banner/email for >5%.
- Auto gates: util+latency+errors -> tiered degrade/rollback ladder.
- Quality via embedding cosine similarity -> alert-only.
- Soft-degrade ladder before full rollback and global quantized fallback if capacity/quality catastrophic.

Ben (Eng): I'll open the rollout-flag PR and include the opt-out endpoint + token-budget limiter. ETA 6h.

Priya (CustomerOps): I'll draft customer email template and portal banner copy.

Tomas (SRE): I'll add the canary pulse and escalation rules to the on-call runbook.

Asha (PM): Great 1. Kickoff scheduled for 09:00 UTC Monday. If anything changes ping @tomas and @ben. :thumbsup:
